## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List relevant commands/results and link CI or sanitized evidence. Identify any
unverified integration or deployment behavior.

## Release impact

State whether this changes application code, dependencies, migrations or hosted
configuration. For database work, describe compatibility and release order; a
merge does not authorize hosted SQL or production promotion.

- [ ] The change is scoped and the applicable validation is recorded.
- [ ] Security/data behavior changes have regression coverage.
- [ ] No credentials, personal records or private exports appear in the diff or evidence.
- [ ] Any remaining release prerequisite or verification limitation is explicit.
